summary: Cosan S.A. files a Form 6-K reporting the pricing of a secondary public offering of common shares of its subsidiary Compass Gás e Energia S.A. Cosan sells 76,785,715 shares at BRL 28.00 per share, receiving BRL 2.15 billion, with an over-allotment option for up to 13,392,857 additional shares. Post-offering, Cosan's direct and indirect ownership in Compass falls from 88% to 77.25% (potentially 75.37%). This is a primary/secondary equity offering by a controlling shareholder, not a special-situation event.
